_fournisseur._lecture: Prix relus chez OpenRouter (GET /api/v1/videos/models) au lancement, avec la formule qui les produit et la date. Un prix estimé n'est pas un montant facturé : le montant réel de chaque clip est relu après coup sur GET /api/v1/generation?id=... et écrit dans cout_usd.

melange-lanterne-accroupi.prompt:
Pixel art game sprite of a single character, side view, orthographic, facing right. Static camera: no zoom, no pan, no rotation. The character stays in the centre of the frame, at the same size, with the same design, colours and equipment from start to end. Plain flat light gray background, nothing else in frame. Timing, over 5 seconds:
- 0.0 to 1.0 s — WALK. The character walks in place at a constant speed, side view, a regular walk cycle, staying centred in the frame.
- 1.0 to 1.5 s — TRANSITION. It slows down and comes to a stop, feet side by side, in a neutral standing pose, arms down.
- 1.5 to 2.5 s — LANTERN. From that neutral pose it raises the lantern with its near hand up above its shoulder and holds it there, lighting the ground in front of it. The rest of the body stays still.
- 2.5 to 3.0 s — TRANSITION. It lowers the lantern back down and returns to exactly the same neutral standing pose as at 1.5 s.
- 3.0 to 4.0 s — CROUCH. It bends its knees and crouches down to the ground, reaching forward with its free hand as if picking something up, then holds the crouch.
- 4.0 to 5.0 s — TRANSITION. It stands back up and returns to exactly the same neutral standing pose again. Every action must be cuttable on its own and loop cleanly: the last frame of an action must lead back into its first frame. Between two actions the character returns to exactly the same neutral standing pose — same position, same size, same posture — so the cut is clean. Follow the timing above strictly. No camera movement, no extra action, the character never leaves the centre of the frame and never turns away from the side view.
